name: Okayama

flag.description: A yellow ring on a dark purple field, with a wing-like bar across the top: the kanji 岡 (oka) drawn in a circle.
flag.symbolism: 岡 is the first character of Okayama, rounded into a ring for unity and progress.

hook: Okayama's yellow emblem on dark purple is 岡 (oka) bent into a ring with wings.
trivia: Kōraku-en in Okayama is one of the Three Great Gardens of Japan.
Okayama is the home of the folk hero Momotarō, the Peach Boy.
